passiveEffects.name: Thick Fat
passiveEffects.originalDescription: When Mamoswine deals damage, Defense and Sp. Def are increased for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. When Mamoswine uses Ice Shard, Icicle Crash or Ice Fang, the next basic attack is boosted. If any of these moves creates a freezing area of effect inside an ally goal zone, the goal-scoring speed of enemies is decreased. When Mamoswine deals damage, Defense and Sp. Def are increased for 5s, stacking up to 3 times. When Mamoswine uses Ice Shard, Icicle Crash or Ice Fang, the next auto attack is boosted. If any of these moves creates a freezing area of effect inside an ally goal zone, the goal-scoring speed of enemies is decreased by 30% for 5s.

If an enemy is hit by all three chunks, they're left frozen for a short time. uniteMoveEffects.name: Mammoth Mash
uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: Mamoswine jumps to the designated location and becomes immune to hindrances - then repeatedly stomps the ground, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their movement speed for a short time with each stomp. The final stomp throws enemies in the air. Mamoswine jumps to the designated location then repeatedly stomps the ground four times, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their movement speed for 0.5s with each stomp. The first stomp slows enemies by 30%, the two mini stomps slow them by 20%, and the final stomp slows them by 40% and throws them in the air for 1.5s. Mamoswine is unstoppable for the duration of the move. Unite buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 40% Max HP Shield
